# Checker fixture

## Scope

Check a fictional two-requirement component.

## Assumptions

Outputs are observed after inputs settle.

## Test cases

| Test ID | Requirement ID | Test intent | Stimulus | Observations | Expected result | Failure criterion |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-A | REQ-A | Exercise A | Apply A | Output A | Specified A | Output differs |
| TC-B | REQ-B | Exercise B | Apply B | Output B | Specified B | Output differs |

## Completion criteria

Both requirements produce their specified observable results.
